papers.title: Casper: Prompt Sanitization for Protecting User Privacy in Web-Based Large Language Models
papers.citation_quote: Casper runs entirely on the user's device as a browser extension
papers.claim: The Casper authors describe client-side sanitization of prompts before transmission to an online LLM, using several detection approaches beyond fixed pattern matching.
papers.source_boundary: Study of Casper's prototype, not an independent evaluation of CloakPipe or verification of a specific user's leak.

papers.title: ALSA: Context-Sensitive Prompt Privacy Preservation in Large Language Models
papers.citation_quote: text anonymization is considered an effective approach to preventing privacy leakage in prompts through text substitution
papers.claim: The ALSA authors study prompt text anonymization and its tension with preserving contextual meaning.
papers.source_boundary: Conference abstract describes ALSA, not a head-to-head test against the pinned CloakPipe experiment.
